decisions.reason: Its sister single-tube condenser and air fin cooler were already withdrawn, so this variant faces consolidation risk, but it remains a standard offering for power and refrigeration customers that fits the established manufacturing base.
Liners for corroded tubes feed the high-margin lifecycle repair business and extend equipment life, in line with the firm's service and sustainability strategy.
The customized industrial air cooler line with several models is the natural home for demand consolidated from the withdrawn single-tube products and matches the firm's customized solutions approach.
Tube end repair inserts strengthen the spare parts and repair offering with low ongoing resource needs and support installed-base service revenue.
